summary: Comprehensive testing of Enhanced Hotel Management Financial System. Backend: 27/28 tests passed (96%). Frontend: All major features verified working. Key features tested: Vendor management with autocomplete, 'Add to Account' payment method creating pending expenses, mark expense as paid, daily/monthly financial reports with receivables/payables, dynamic categories, download Excel/PDF.

minor.issue: Staff user (staff1/staff123) login fails with 'Incorrect username or password'. User may not exist in database.

issues: Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - Recharts sizing issue on initial render, charts still display correctly after data loads

login_admin.details: Admin login with admin/admin123 works correctly

vendor_management.details: GET /api/vendors, POST /api/vendors, vendor search with ?search=xxx all working. Vendor autocomplete in expense form shows dropdown with matching vendors.

add_to_account_payment.details: Payment Method dropdown includes 'Add to Account' option. Creating expense with 'Add to Account' sets payment_status to 'Pending'.

vendor_auto_save.details: When creating expense with new vendor name, vendor is automatically saved to vendors collection

dynamic_categories.details: GET/POST /api/categories/expense and /api/categories/income working. UI shows '+ Add' button for inline category creation.

daily_financial_summary.details: GET /api/daily-financial-summary returns pending_receivables and pending_payables fields

daily_sales_tab.details: Shows date picker, 5 summary cards (Received, Paid, Receivables, Payables, Net Position), Excel and PDF download buttons

monthly_sales_tab.details: Shows month/year selectors, day-by-day ledger table with all days of month, Grand Total row, Excel and PDF download buttons

monthly_report_api.details: GET /api/financial-reports/monthly returns daily_breakdown array with all days and grand_totals object with received_cash, received_bank, paid_cash, paid_bank, pending_payables, net_balance

overview_tab.details: Shows 6 summary cards (Today's Received, Today's Paid, Cash Balance, Bank Balance, Receivables, Payables) and 2 charts (Daily Revenue & Expenses, Net Profit Trend)

records_tab.details: Shows expense records with STATUS column displaying 'Paid' badges. Pending expenses would show 'Pending' badge.

expense_management.details: POST /api/expenses, GET /api/expenses, DELETE /api/expenses/{id} all working with payment_status field

action_items: Create staff1 user in database if staff login is required (currently only admin user exists)
Minor: Fix Recharts console warning about chart dimensions (cosmetic issue, charts work correctly)
critical_code_review_comments: Expense model correctly includes vendor (str) and payment_status ('Paid'/'Pending') fields
Payment method 'Add to Account' correctly sets payment_status to 'Pending'
Monthly report daily_breakdown correctly includes all days of the month with proper financial fields
Vendor autocomplete working with search API

success_rate.backend: 96% (27/28 tests pass - only staff login fails)

seed_data_creation: Test vendors (TEST_Vendor_*, TEST_AutoVendor_*, TEST_MarkPaid_Vendor, TEST_Payables_Vendor), test categories (TEST_ExpCat_*, TEST_IncCat_*) created during testing and cleaned up
context_for_next_testing_agent: All enhanced financial features implemented and working. Key APIs: GET /api/daily-financial-summary (includes pending_receivables, pending_payables), GET /api/financial-reports/daily?date=YYYY-MM-DD, GET /api/financial-reports/monthly?year=YYYY&month=MM (returns daily_breakdown array with all days). Expense model has vendor and payment_status fields. Payment method 'Add to Account' creates Pending expense. PUT /api/expenses/{id}/mark-paid marks as Paid. Vendor autocomplete via GET /api/vendors?search=xxx. Dynamic categories via GET/POST /api/categories/{expense|income}.
